description: Show something you have made or helped build. Personal, study and team projects all belong here, with or without a public repository.
empty: Add a project and share whichever details are useful. Every field is optional.
name: Project name
nameHelp: Your project name becomes a clickable title when you add a URL.
projectDescriptionHelp: Describe what the project does, what you contributed or your role, and the technologies you used.
projectDescriptionPlaceholder: A small guide built with TypeScript to help people find local learning resources.
titleUrlHelp: Optional. Clicking the title opens this address. Use the app or repository URL here; add social profiles in Contact.
invalidTitleUrl: Enter a full public http:// or https:// address without credentials or spaces.
coverHelp: Public HTTPS images, including animated GIFs, are supported. For a sharp, lightweight preview, choose a landscape 16:9 image around 960 × 540 px (displayed up to 480 px wide), under 1 MB if static, and around 2–3 MB or less for a short, subtle GIF. These sizes are recommendations, not enforced limits. The editor does not upload, resize, or compress images. GitHub controls the final layout.
coverAltHelp: Describe what the preview shows. Required when you add an image.
coverAltPlaceholder: Resource guide showing a map and search results
invalidCoverUrl: Use a public HTTPS image URL without credentials, fragments or a custom port. Very long values may also exceed the HTML export limit.
missingCoverAlt: Describe the image so people can understand the preview without seeing it.
removeHelp: Removing a project deletes all of its saved content from this draft.
